definition: Nombre de demandes de la cohorte préparée
inclusions: Unique keyed cohort; delay KPI: observable valid dates, nonnegative elapsed duration <=3650 days
exclusions: Missing keys and repeated keys excluded from clean rows; invalid/missing durations excluded only from delay denominators; n<30 not ranked
limitations: Unweighted nonrandom systematic sample for detailed durations; no population inference
Monthly cohort closure rate changes with follow-up time
Monthly official volumes are not sample volumes
Agency case mix and missing rare strata limit comparisons
No causal, staffing or SLA conclusion; backlog excludes pre-cohort requests and unobserved reopenings
